whenToUse: Structures of unknown depth, such as files and folders.
People need to move across several levels to choose items.
You show the position within the whole structure too.
whenNotToUse: Menus with only one or two levels (use a sidebar or an accordion).
Mobile screens (a list that moves screen by screen is easier).

alternatives.name: Sidebar Navigation
alternatives.reason: Shallow structures such as app menus.

accessibility: Use a WAI-ARIA tree: role="tree", treeitem, and group with aria-level.
The whole tree is one Tab stop; ↑/↓ move, → expands or enters, and ← collapses or goes to the parent.
Folders announce their state with aria-expanded and files with aria-selected.
Home and End move to the first and last items.
